items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
items.claim: Verse 8:20 says the LORD told Moses to rise early and meet Pharaoh as Pharaoh came out to the water. Moses was to give him the demand 'Let my people go, that they may serve me.' This is what the text says. It does not show that the event happened.
items.action: orders Moses to confront Pharaoh and demand the release of the people
items.place: at the water where Pharaoh comes out (the text does not name the place)
items.mechanism: a divine command passed on by a messenger (Moses) to a ruler, with the stated purpose of letting the people serve their god
